title: Japanese space tech startup Letara expands beyond satellite thrusters with $16M
summary: Japanese space startup Letara is betting its hybrid rocket technology can move beyond small satellite thrusters into a broader market for space, defense and security, after raising ¥2.6 billion ($16 million).
llm_summary: Japanese startup Letara has raised ¥2.6 billion ($16 million) to commercialize its hybrid‑rocket propulsion system, which it originally developed for small‑satellite thrusters. The company now aims to expand the technology into broader space, defense and security markets, positioning the hybrid engine as a flexible, low‑cost alternative to traditional propulsion.
